children: Indu Bhan New Delhi: Hospital chain Fortis Healthcare (FHL) on Wednesday moved the Supreme Court against a Delhi High Court August 31 order directing a forensic audit to investigate transactions between it, Malaysia's IHH Healthcare Berhad and RHT Health Trust floated by FHL's former promoters-Malvinder Singh and Shivinder Singh-and their Religare group of entities. "Terming the HC directions as "highly prejudicial findings" against it, FHL told the SC that it was "a complete stranger to the award, not a party to the arbitration and admittedly not a judgment debtor or garnishee, and cannot be made one through execution proceedings" filed by Japanese drug major Daiichi Sankyo.

According to FHL, only Singh Brothers and their respective families and family-owned and controlled companies were parties to the arbitration. Neither FHL nor IHH Healthcare Berhad, the subsequent investor in 2018, nor its approximate 2.5 lakh public shareholders were directly, indirectly or even remotely involved in or parties to the arbitration/recovery proceedings.

title: Fortis Moves SC over Forensic Audit Order
